limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Infinite resolutions over radical-square-zero rings and the identification of Tor_n^A(DA,DA) with the derived part of the Serre square are prior work. The novelty claim is restricted to the explicit all-degree family/formula and its use to show that the bounded finite-row premise of Theorem 4.1 in arXiv:2609.20220v1 fails without a finite Tor-amplitude hypothesis. The exact Tor formula may occur in older local-homological literature under different notation, and the recent v1 may be independently corrected. No claim is made that the Serre-Hochschild plane itself is ill-defined or that all conclusions of the source paper fail.
record_title: Unbounded Serre-square homology for square-zero local algebras
